card.name: Start of 'str-' verbs like strangled
card.fires_on: The opening piece 'str' (also 'Str') of words like strangled, stricken, strung and stranded, usually right after a form of 'was', 'be' or 'already'. It also fires weakly on a few other word starts such as 'w' in wavered.

modes.label: strangled / stranded
modes.description: The start of 'strangled' or 'stranded' in stories or quiz questions about violence or being stuck.
modes.example: (by some accounts he was hung, according to another he was<< str>>angled)

modes.label: stricken / strung
modes.description: The start of 'stricken' or 'strung' as a past participle after 'was', 'is' or a noun.
modes.example: When the bow is<< str>>ung correctly you will find that your right

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: The start of other past-tense verbs after 'was' or 'but later'.
modes.example: but later<< w>>avered in his judgment

card.writes: It favours verbs of cutting, setting, putting, splitting and spreading, and suppresses 'setting' forms.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of words like strangled, stricken and strung, just after a 'was' or 'is'.
